nodes.description: Storage slot 'admin' of CEtherDelegator; set to msg.sender in the constructor and later to admin_.
Storage slot 'implementation'; address of the implementation contract all delegatecalls are forwarded to.
constructor(...): initializes the delegator, delegates to implementation initialize(), sets implementation and admin.
_setImplementation(address,bool,bytes): admin-only setter that swaps the implementation and optionally calls _resign/_becomeImplementation via delegatecall.
delegateTo(address,bytes): internal helper performing a raw delegatecall and bubbling up reverts.
delegateToImplementation(bytes): public wrapper that delegatecalls into the current implementation.
Payable fallback function forwarding msg.data via delegatecall to the implementation and returning raw returndata.
msg.sender: caller used to grant admin rights in the constructor and checked by hasAdminRights().
callee.delegatecall(data) inside delegateTo: arbitrary external code executed in the storage context of the delegator.
implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) inside the fallback: fully attacker-controlled calldata executed in the delegator's storage context.
admin = msg.sender assignment in constructor: unconditional privilege grant to the deployer.
require(hasAdminRights()) guard in _setImplementation: access-control enforcement for implementation upgrades.
Constructor parameter comptroller_ forwarded to initialize().
Constructor parameter interestRateModel_ forwarded to initialize().
Constructor parameter initialExchangeRateMantissa_ forwarded to initialize().
Constructor parameter name_ forwarded to initialize().
Constructor parameter symbol_ forwarded to initialize().
Constructor parameter decimals_ forwarded to initialize().

Constructor parameter adminFeeMantissa_ forwarded to initialize().
delegateTo parameter callee: target address of the delegatecall.
delegateTo / delegateToImplementation parameter data: raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
_setImplementation parameter allowResign: controls whether _resignImplementation is delegatecalled.
Local variable in _setImplementation caching the previous implementation address for the NewImplementation event.
Local bool 'success' holding the delegatecall result inside delegateTo.
Local bytes 'returnData' holding the delegatecall returndata inside delegateTo.
Local bool 'success' holding the delegatecall result inside the fallback function.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written directly into the admin storage slot, granting full admin rights to the deployer without any validation.
The constructor performs the unconditional admin = msg.sender privilege assignment.
Constructor parameter admin_ overwrites the admin storage slot at the end of the constructor, replacing the deployer as admin.
The constructor calls delegateTo() to invoke initialize() on the implementation.
The constructor calls _setImplementation() to register the first implementation.
Parameter implementation_ is stored into the implementation slot, redirecting all future delegatecalls.
_setImplementation is gated by require(hasAdminRights()) before any implementation change.
msg.sender is the value checked by hasAdminRights() inside the access-control guard.
_setImplementation calls delegateToImplementation() for _resignImplementation and _becomeImplementation.
becomeImplementationData is encoded into the calldata forwarded through delegateToImplementation.
delegateToImplementation() forwards execution to the internal delegateTo() helper.
The implementation storage slot is read to determine the delegatecall target.
User-supplied data parameter is passed as raw calldata to delegateTo().
The callee parameter is the target address of the raw delegatecall performed inside delegateTo.
delegateTo executes callee.delegatecall(data), the unsafe low-level delegatecall operation.
The delegatecall target executes arbitrary code in the delegator's context and can call back into the delegator's public/external entry points.
The fallback function performs an unconditional delegatecall using attacker-controlled msg.data.
The implementation storage address is used as the delegatecall target in the fallback function.
The delegatecall in the fallback runs untrusted implementation code with the delegator's storage and can re-enter the fallback (e.g. via Ether transfers).
The allowResign flag controls whether the _resignImplementation delegatecall branch is taken in _setImplementation.
oldImplementation is a local that caches the previous implementation slot value inside _setImplementation.
The success flag is the local result of the delegatecall checked in the assembly revert branch inside delegateTo.
returnData is the local returndata buffer produced by the delegatecall inside delegateTo.
The success flag is the local result of the fallback delegatecall used to decide between revert and return.
